name: Vercel Hobby
free_limit: 100 GB Fast Data Transfer; included serverless functions
watch_out: Hobby is restricted to personal, non-commercial projects; usage caps pause services.

name: Netlify Free
free_limit: 300 credits/month on new credit-based plans; custom domains and SSL
watch_out: Production deploys, requests, bandwidth and compute all consume credits; legacy accounts may differ.

name: Cloudflare Pages
free_limit: 500 builds/month; up to 20,000 files/site on Free
watch_out: Pages Functions consume the separate Workers quota; 20-minute build timeout.

name: GitHub Pages
free_limit: Static sites from public repositories; 1 GB site limit; ~100 GB/month soft bandwidth
watch_out: Not permitted as free hosting for an online business, e-commerce site or commercial SaaS.

name: Firebase Hosting (Spark)
free_limit: 10 GB stored; 360 MB/day transferred; custom domain and SSL
watch_out: Firebase App Hosting is a different product and is not available on Spark.

name: Azure Static Web Apps Free
free_limit: 100 GB bandwidth per subscription; 2 custom domains/app
watch_out: Intended for hobby/personal apps; site becomes unavailable after exceeding bandwidth quota.

name: Render Static Sites
free_limit: Free static-site deployments with automatic TLS
watch_out: Outbound bandwidth and build minutes share workspace quotas; excess usage may be billable.

name: Render Free Web Services
free_limit: 750 shared free instance hours/workspace/month
watch_out: Services sleep after inactivity; no persistent local disk. Not recommended for production.

name: Koyeb Free Web Instance
free_limit: One Free instance: 512 MB RAM, 0.1 vCPU, 2 GB SSD
watch_out: Limited regions; sleeps after an hour without traffic; no persistent volumes.

name: Railway Free
free_limit: $1 monthly credit after an initial up-to-30-day $5 trial
watch_out: Usage beyond recurring free credit requires checking billing and available resources.

name: Deno Deploy Free
free_limit: 1 million requests/month; 20 GiB egress/month; 5 custom domains
watch_out: Runtime, resource and team restrictions apply; inspect current deployment pricing.

name: Cloudflare Workers Free
free_limit: 100,000 requests/day; 10 ms CPU time per invocation
watch_out: Functions on Pages share this quota; not a general-purpose always-on server.

name: Google Cloud Run
free_limit: 2 million requests/month under eligible request-based billing
watch_out: A Cloud Billing account is required; builds, logging and network usage can incur charges.

name: Oracle Cloud Always Free Compute
free_limit: Eligible AMD and Arm Ampere A1 compute resources
watch_out: Requires a valid payment card for identity verification; region capacity and inactivity policies apply.

name: Google Compute Engine Free Tier
free_limit: One eligible e2-micro VM/month; 30 GB standard disk; 1 GB eligible egress
watch_out: Only selected US regions qualify; billing account required; other usage can be charged.

name: AWS Free Plan
free_limit: Eligible new accounts: up to six months or until Free Tier credits run out
watch_out: NOT an indefinite free VPS; different AWS offers have separate eligibility and limits.

name: Supabase Free
free_limit: 500 MB Postgres database/project; 2 active projects; 1 GB file storage
watch_out: Free projects pause after one week of inactivity; restore/backups are limited.

name: Turso Free
free_limit: 100 databases; 5 GB storage; 500M rows read and 10M rows written/month
watch_out: Read/write usage and sync limits apply; re-check pricing before production use.

name: MongoDB Atlas Free Cluster
free_limit: 512 MB storage; one Free cluster per project
watch_out: Limited regions, throughput and cluster capabilities; designed for development.

name: Upstash Redis Free
free_limit: 256 MB data; 500,000 commands/month; 10 GB monthly bandwidth
watch_out: One Free database; claim temporary instant-created databases to prevent expiry.

name: Cloudflare D1 Free
free_limit: 5 GB total storage; 5M rows read/day; 100k rows written/day
watch_out: Daily limits stop queries on exhaustion; associated Workers usage has its own quota.

name: Render Free Postgres
free_limit: 1 GB database, one free instance/workspace
watch_out: Database EXPIRES after 30 days; not suitable for durable production data.

name: Firebase Realtime Database (Spark)
free_limit: 1 GB stored; ~10 GB/month downloaded; 100 concurrent connections
watch_out: Spark limits and feature eligibility vary; avoid assuming unlimited usage.

name: Cloudflare R2 Standard
free_limit: 10 GB-month storage; 1M Class A + 10M Class B operations/month
watch_out: Free allowance covers Standard class only; operations beyond limits incur charges.

name: Google Cloud Storage Free Tier
free_limit: 5 GB-months in eligible US regions; 5,000 Class A and 50,000 Class B operations
watch_out: Eligible regions only; Cloud Billing required; egress rules are destination-dependent.

name: Oracle Object Storage Always Free
free_limit: Always Free object-storage allowance on eligible OCI accounts
watch_out: Card verification required; quotas and capacity can vary by service and region.

name: Resend Free
free_limit: 3,000 transactional emails/month; 100/day; up to 3 domains
watch_out: Daily sending cap and deliverability/domain-verification requirements apply.

name: Better Stack Free
free_limit: 10 monitors/heartbeats; 1 status page
watch_out: Free personal-project tier; alert channels and log retention have limits.

name: GitHub Actions
free_limit: Standard GitHub-hosted runners free for public repos; 2,000 minutes/month on GitHub Free private repos
watch_out: Larger runners and over-quota private-repo usage may be billed.
